question: On which date, Major Dhyanchand's birthday is celebrated as National Sports Day in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29th August**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand's birthday is celebrated as National Sports Day in India on August 29**
 
• The Indian government has celebrated **National Sports Day on August 29 since 2012** to honour the birth anniversary of the legendary hockey player.
 
• **The day is meant to raise awareness about the importance of sports in people's lives.**
 
• It also serves as a reminder of the value of sports in promoting physical fitness, mental health, and overall well-being. 
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand, also known as "The Wizard of Hockey", was a key contributor to India's national sport.**
 
• He was a member of the Indian hockey team that won **Olympic gold medals in 1928, 1932, and 1936.**
 
• He **was also the recipient of the Padma Bhushan in 1956. **
